name: PHT Stablecoin
oneLiner: PHT is APACX's Philippine peso CDP stablecoin using approved stablecoin collateral such as USDC/USDT, with apcxUSDT live in beta transparency.
collateral: All existing PHT is claimed by APACX to have been minted using custodial apcxUSDT backed 1:1 by USDT at the disclosed Tron reserve address TCRjE31cgksHetFLQd6JENAfBfXhHjMEFU; direct USDT, USDC, and other collateral are described as future/instructional, while the unreconciled live ILK conflict remains disclosed.
pegMechanism: Overcollateralized CDP vaults (MakerDAO MCD fork): users deposit approved collateral to mint PHT; undercollateralized vaults liquidate through independent Dutch auctions; live stablecoin paths divide Chainlink stablecoin/USD numerators by an owner-set APACX PHP/USD denominator; LayerZero OFT supports cross-chain bridging
